dial.summary: Real yields eased to 2.74% (from 2.80%) but remain a headwind alongside DXY at 101.68; Global M2 holds at $103.7T with a supportive 4-week trend; BTC dominance ticked up to 59.7%, firmly above the 55% alt-rotation threshold, and funding rates at 0.0100% per 8h confirm low-leverage spot accumulation ahead of the October 28 FOMC decision.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: G4 M2 aggregate (Fed/ECB/BOJ/PBOC) at ~$103.7T for August 2026 (latest month with all four economies reporting; July $102.64T → August $103.66T, +$1.02T, +1.0% MoM); US M2 at $23.34T for August (FRED H.6, up 5.7% YoY); September G4 aggregate unavailable (6–8 week reporting lag); 4-week trend UP; status supportive (4-week trend is up); next full G4 update expected mid-November 2026.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: September 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI at 54.5% (released Oct 1, 2026; August 54.6%, 4-week change −0.1pp within flat threshold); ninth consecutive month above 50; New Orders 55.3, Production 56.7, Prices Paid 77.9% (multi-year high); October PMI scheduled November 2, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET; status neutral (above 50 but not rising on 4-week basis).

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY spot at ~101.68 (Oct 21, 2026 close per Trading Economics; 101.6801, −0.10% on the session); 4-week trend UP from ~100.29 on Sep 18 (+1.4%); pulled back from Oct 14 intraday high of ~102.94 (52-week high); 52-week range 95.55–102.95; status headwind (above 100 threshold); FOMC Oct 28 decision is the next major DXY catalyst.

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield (DFII10) at 2.74% as of October 16, 2026 (released Oct 19; prior readings: Oct 14 = 2.84%, Oct 15 = 2.78%, Oct 16 = 2.74%); 4-week trend UP from ~2.52% on Sep 15 to 2.74% (+22bps); status headwind (rising on 4-week basis and above 2% threshold); 52-week range 1.68% (Oct 22, 2025) to 2.95% (Oct 5, 2026).

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: October 21, 2026: 10Y at 5.13% and 2Y at 4.82% (Trading Economics/Forbes); 2s10s spread at +0.31% (+31bps); 4-week trend DOWN from ~+0.42% (+42bps) on Sep 19 to +0.31% (−11bps flattening); curve remains positively sloped; status neutral (positive but flattening into FOMC Oct 28 decision).

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL at $6.756T for week ending October 14, 2026 (H.4.1 released Oct 15; 6,755,639 million per FRED; prior weeks: Oct 7 = $6.748T, Sep 30 = $6.743T, Sep 23 = $6.748T); 4-week trend flat: Sep 23 $6.748T → Oct 14 $6.756T = +$8B (+0.1%); H.4.1 for week ending Oct 21 scheduled release today (Oct 22) at 4:30 PM ET; status supportive (flat near post-QT-pause stabilization plateau).

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: BTC weighted 8h perp funding rate at ~0.0100% as of October 20, 2026 (Convex/TokenPost; longs 62.5% vs shorts 37.5%); 30-day trend UP from ~0.0067% on Sep 30 to 0.0100%; well below the 0.04% per 8h overheating threshold; status supportive (low-leverage accumulation, no speculative excess); Oct 30 Deribit options expiry (35% of open interest) is a near-term catalyst.

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap ~$301.3B (Stablecoin Beat Oct 21, 2026; USDT 60.67%) vs total crypto ~$2.85T (TV-Hub Oct 2026); dominance ~10.6%; BTC.D at 59.7% (up from prior 59.4%); 30-day trend flat (Sep ~10.5% → Oct ~10.6%); status neutral — headwind condition (rising dominance + rising TOTAL simultaneously) not triggered.

upcoming.title: S&P Global US Flash PMI (October 2026)
upcoming.note: S&P Global releases preliminary October 2026 Manufacturing and Services PMI at 9:45 AM ET — first Q4 activity data point, released five days before the FOMC meeting begins; September ISM Manufacturing at 54.5% sets a high bar; a flash manufacturing print below 52 would suggest deceleration and reinforce Fed hold expectations despite hot inflation.

upcoming.title: UMich Consumer Sentiment Final (October 2026)
upcoming.note: University of Michigan releases the final October 2026 Consumer Sentiment Index at 10:00 AM ET; this final print closes out the pre-FOMC consumer confidence picture ahead of the Oct 27–28 meeting; any sharp downward revision would reinforce stagflation concerns given September CPI at 3.7% YoY and still-elevated mortgage rates.

upcoming.title: Conference Board Consumer Confidence (October 2026)
upcoming.note: Conference Board releases October 2026 Consumer Confidence Index at 10:00 AM ET — most recent reading was 89.4 (August 2026); released on the same day FOMC Day 1 begins; a sharp drop would reinforce stagflation concerns heading into the Oct 28 decision, while a hold or uptick would reduce pressure on the Fed to slow its hiking pace.

upcoming.title: FOMC Meeting Begins (Day 1 of 2; decision October 28)
upcoming.note: Federal Reserve October 2026 FOMC 2-day meeting opens; policy decision and press conference on October 28 at 2:00 PM ET; current Fed Funds target 3.75%–4.00% (raised 25bps on Sep 16, 2026); back-to-back inflation shocks — CPI 3.7% YoY (Oct 14) and PPI 6.3% YoY (Oct 15) — and DXY at 101.68 with real yields at 2.74% sustain elevated 25bp hike probability.

upcoming.title: FOMC Rate Decision & Press Conference (October 2026)
upcoming.note: Federal Reserve releases the October 2026 FOMC rate decision at 2:00 PM ET, followed by Chair press conference; current target: 3.75%–4.00%; back-to-back inflation shocks (CPI 3.7% YoY, PPI 6.3% YoY) sustain probability of a 25bp hike to 4.00%–4.25% — which would push DXY above 103 and extend real yield headwinds for risk assets; a hawkish hold is the binary alternative.

upcoming.title: GDP Q3 2026 Advance Estimate
upcoming.note: BEA releases Q3 2026 GDP advance estimate at 8:30 AM ET — first read on Q3 output; September ISM Manufacturing at 54.5% and elevated Prices Paid suggest continued expansion; September Retail Sales beat (+0.8% MoM vs +0.3% expected, released Oct 15) adds further evidence of Q3 resilience; released same day as PCE and one day after FOMC decision.

upcoming.title: PCE Deflator (September 2026)
upcoming.note: BEA releases September 2026 Personal Consumption Expenditures Price Index at 8:30 AM ET — the Fed's preferred inflation gauge; released the day after the FOMC decision; a hot PCE following hot CPI (3.7% YoY) and hot PPI (6.3% YoY) would validate any Oct 28 hike and sustain DXY and real yield headwinds into Q4 2026; September Retail Sales beat (+0.8% MoM) supports continued demand-driven price pressure.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended October 25, 2026)
upcoming.note: DOL weekly initial jobless claims at 8:30 AM ET for the week ended October 25, 2026 — first post-FOMC labor read; released same day as GDP advance estimate and PCE; any sharp spike above 230K would immediately test the Oct 28 hike narrative and weigh on risk assets.

upcoming.title: ECB Rate Decision (October 2026)
upcoming.note: European Central Bank Governing Council rate decision on October 29, 2026 at 14:15 CET (no new staff projections at this meeting); current ECB deposit rate at 2.50% (raised Sep 16, 2026); market pricing implied ~60% probability of a 25bp hike to 2.75%; a hawkish hike could strengthen EUR and ease DXY headwinds for risk assets; released same day as US GDP and PCE advance estimates.
